title: HAI governance re-check — 5% quorum vs 122k-vote defence bloc; acquisition route analysis
closed_reasons: Quorum is 48,698.35 KITE (~$15,030.55) but the live defence bloc is 122,423.63 votes (5 delegates, 12.57% of supply); a quorum-only proposal is Defeated 122,423.63 -> 48,698.35 (fork test 02).

No market route to the winning 122,423.63 KITE: two Velodrome pools hold 22,220.21 KITE total ($6,827.59 quote), no CEX listing (CoinGecko tickers = 2 Velodrome pools), no bridge/other-chain float (DexScreener returns only Optimism pairs).
The winning stake equals 71.3% of all EOA-held KITE (171,750.63) — requires 6-8 whales to sell OTC, publicly visible for 6.5 days.

Treasury KITE is realizable at only $6,508 (both pools drained); the $101,348 mark is not achievable. All-in quorum cost $17.5k-$29.5k > realizable treasury $6,576 => net-negative on the treasury leg.
Votes are timestamp checkpoints (getPastVotes): not flash-loanable; delegation must be checkpointed 12h before voteStart.
No guardian; TIMELOCK_ADMIN unassigned; the only proposer is the Governor; no faster path than 12h + 5d + 1d.

caveats: The attacker's 48.7k/130k KITE balance is a state override (deal cheatcode) — hypothetical capital, no such on-chain balance.
Defender votes in tests 02/03 are the real undealt live delegations (no override).
OTC premiums are unobservable; cost modelled at spot and 2x. DEX legs are exact constant-product with 30 bp.
Collateral seizure is a governance capability, not unprivileged; it requires winning the 5-day vote and could be met with off-chain emergency action (pause/disableContract) not modelled.
P category is nominal mark value of governance-reachable assets (treasury + StakingManager + HAI TVL); realizable value is far lower (~$6.5k for treasury KITE).
All reads are point-in-time; staking balance and prices move.
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live: quorum is 48,698.35 KITE ($15,030.55) but the live defence bloc is 122,423.63 votes (2.51x quorum), no CEX/bridge/DEX route can source the 122k winning stake (71% of the EOA float), and the treasury's KITE only exits at $6,508 — CA3's re-opening rests on an unsupported $0.1139 KITE price and a 1,000x quorum typo.
